name: Muntith, Windborne Skydragon of the Shining Sun
printed_text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects the turn it is Synchro Summoned. If this card is Synchro Summoned using only "Windborne" monsters: You can banish all monsters your opponent controls until the End Phase. During the End Phase: You can target 1 "Windborne" monster in your GY; add that target to your hand during your next Standby Phase. You can only use each effect of "Muntith, Windborne Skydragon of the Shining Sun" once per turn.
body:
function s.delayop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	local tc=e:GetLabelObject()
	if tc:IsAbleToHand() and aux.NecroValleyFilter()(tc) then
		Duel.SendtoHand(tc,nil,REASON_EFFECT)
		Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,tc)
	end
end

name: Janna, Windborne Goddess of the Temple
printed_text: You can also reveal up to 2 "Windborne" Spells in your hand to activate this effect; Special Summon this card from your hand by shuffling up to 2 cards from your hand into the Deck, including "Windborne" Spells you revealed to activate this effect (if any), and if you do, during the next Standby Phase, add a "Windborne" card from your Deck to your hand for each card you shuffled into the Deck by this effect, except "Janna, Windborne Goddess of the Temple", then Set "Windborne" Quick-Play Spells directly from your Deck for each card you revealed to activate this effect. The Set Quick-Play Spell(s) can be activated that turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Windborne" card from your Deck to the GY, then you can shuffle 1 "Windborne" card with a different name from your GY into the Deck, or, if it is a Spell/Trap, you can Set it to your field. You can only use each effect of "Janna, Windborne Goddess of the Temple" once per turn.
body:
function s.thop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	local lbl=e:GetLabel()
	local ct1 = lbl & 0xffff
	local ct2 = lbl >> 16
	Duel.Hint(HINT_CARD,0,id)
	local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.addfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil)
	ct1=math.min(ct1,#g)
	if ct1>0 then
		Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_ATOHAND)
		local sg=g:Select(tp,ct1,ct1,nil)
		if Duel.SendtoHand(sg,nil,REASON_EFFECT)>0 then
			Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,sg)
			if ct2>0 then
				local sg2=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.setfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil)
				ct2=math.min(ct2,#sg2)
				if ct2>0 then
					Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_SET)
					local setg=sg2:Select(tp,ct2,ct2,nil)
					if #setg>0 then
						Duel.SSet(tp,setg)
						for tc in aux.Next(setg) do
							local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(e:GetOwner())
							e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
							e1:SetCode(EFFECT_QP_ACT_IN_SET_TURN)
							e1:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_SET_AVAILABLE)
							e1:SetReset(RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD)
							tc:RegisterEffect(e1)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

body:
function s.thop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	local label=e:GetLabel()
	local shuf_ct=label%10
	local rev_ct=math.floor(label/10)
	Duel.Hint(HINT_CARD,0,id)
	local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.thfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil,id)
	if #g>=shuf_ct then
		Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_ATOHAND)
		local sg=g:Select(tp,shuf_ct,shuf_ct,nil)
		if Duel.SendtoHand(sg,nil,REASON_EFFECT)>0 then
			Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,sg)
			if rev_ct>0 then
				local setg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.setfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil)
				if #setg>=rev_ct then
					Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_SET)
					local ssg=setg:Select(tp,rev_ct,rev_ct,nil)
					Duel.SSet(tp,ssg)
					for tc in aux.Next(ssg) do
						local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(e:GetHandler())
						e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
						e1:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_SET_AVAILABLE)
						e1:SetCode(EFFECT_TRAP_ACT_IN_SET_TURN)
						e1:SetReset(RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD)
						tc:RegisterEffect(e1)
						local e2=e1:Clone()
						e2:SetCode(EFFECT_QP_ACT_IN_SET_TURN)
						tc:RegisterEffect(e2)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

name: Windborne Divine Whirlwind
printed_text: Target up to 2 "Windborne" cards in your GY, except "Windborne Divine Whirlwind"; add them to your hand during the next Standby Phase, or Set them to your field, then, if you added 3 or more "Windborne" cards from your Deck to your hand this turn, you can Special Summon 1 non-Synchro "Windborne" monster from your Deck or GY.
body:
function s.thop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	local fid=e:GetLabel()
	local tg=e:GetLabelObject()
	local g=tg:Filter(s.thfilter,nil,fid)
	if #g>0 then
		g=g:Filter(aux.NecroValleyFilter(),nil)
		g=g:Filter(Card.IsAbleToHand,nil)
		if #g>0 and Duel.SendtoHand(g,nil,REASON_EFFECT)>0 then
			local hg=g:Filter(Card.IsLocation,nil,LOCATION_HAND)
			if #hg>0 then Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,hg) end
		end
	end
	tg:DeleteGroup()
	e:Reset()
end

name: Scion of Nephthys
printed_text: (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card from your hand; destroy 1 "Nephthys" monster from your hand or field, then Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual or Level 8 "Nephthys" monster from your Deck to your hand. During your next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can add 1 "Nephthys" card from your GY to your hand, then if "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" activated its effect this turn, you can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Scion of Nephthys" once per turn.
body:
function s.recoverop(e,tp)
 Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_ATOHAND)
 local g=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,aux.NecroValleyFilter(s.recoverfilter),tp,LOCATION_GRAVE,0,1,1,nil)
 if #g==0 or Duel.SendtoHand(g,nil,REASON_EFFECT)==0 or not g:GetFirst():IsLocation(LOCATION_HAND) then return end
 Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,g)
 local c=e:GetHandler()
 if c:IsRelateToEffect(e) and c:IsLocation(LOCATION_GRAVE) and Duel.GetFlagEffect(tp,PHOENIX_FLAG)>0
  and Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0 and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,false,false)
  and Duel.SelectYesNo(tp,aux.Stringid(MSG_ID,3)) then
  Duel.SpecialSummon(c,0,tp,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP)
 end
end
